definitions.gloss: lactose; the sugar naturally present in milk
definitions.explanation: The sugar naturally present in milk and dairy products. Formed from 乳 (milk) and 糖 (sugar). Relevant in discussions of food ingredients, nutrition, and lactose intolerance.

examples.japanese: {乳糖|にゅうとう}を{含|ふく}む{食品|しょくひん}。
チーズには{乳糖|にゅうとう}がほとんど{含|ふく}まれていない。
{乳糖不耐症|にゅうとうふたいしょう}の{人|ひと}は{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}を{飲|の}むとお{腹|なか}を{壊|こわ}すことがある。
examples.english: People with lactose intolerance may get an upset stomach from drinking cow's milk.

notes:
Scientific/nutritional term from {乳|にゅう} (milk) + {糖|とう} (sugar). Commonly encountered in food labeling and health discussions.

RELATED WORDS:
- {乳糖不耐症|にゅうとうふたいしょう}: lactose intolerance
- {乳製品|にゅうせいひん}: dairy products
- {砂糖|さとう}: sugar (table sugar)
- {果糖|かとう}: fructose (fruit sugar)
